job_dir.ask: Folder the RheoCompass workflow takes job files from
job_dir.help: The folder the lab's Test Analysis Designer workflow, AP Connect task or operator routine watches (see references/rheocompass_files.md). Must exist and be writable by the account running mhp on the RheoCompass PC.

results_dir.ask: Folder where the ASCII exports of the queued tests are written
results_dir.help: The export folder of the workflow's export action; the package waits for <sample_name>_<token>.txt there.

hood_state_file.ask: One-line file that reads 'closed' when the hood is down (blank if the lab has no way to write it)
hood_state_file.help: The MCR does not report its hood. A workflow step or a switch script writes 'closed' or 'open' here; without it the hood_closed interlock stays open and queue_test refuses.

live_export_file.ask: Live export file the workflow keeps writing during a test (blank if none)

equilibration_s.ask: Seconds the temperature device needs before the first point (for progress and the wait)

max_test_hours.ask: Longest test an agent may queue (hours)

poll_s.ask: Seconds between checks of the results folder

result_wait_s.ask: Longest wait for a result before the job fails (seconds)
